ohtani.title: Emmet Sheehan's superb outing fuels Dodgers' 6-3 win
ohtani.blurb: Teoscar Hernández belts a three-run homer and Emmet Sheehan strikes out 10 to lead the Dodgers over the Reds, 6-3

imanaga.title: Shota Imanaga's strong start leads Cubs to 6-1 win
imanaga.blurb: Shota Imanaga tosses six dominant innings and Michael Busch slugs a home run to lead the Cubs to a 6-1 win over the Marlins

suzuki.title: Brewers crush three homers in win vs. Cubs
suzuki.blurb: Christian Yelich, Jackson Chourio and William Contreras each belt homers in the Brewers' 8-6 win over the Cubs

yoshida.title: Sonny Gray, Wilyer Abreu shine in 4-0 shutout win
yoshida.blurb: Seven innings of shutout ball from Sonny Gray and Wilyer Abreu's 22nd homer of the year lead the Red Sox to a 4-0 win over the Pirates

okamoto.title: Bolte, Basso lead A's to 2-0 shutout win
okamoto.blurb: Henry Bolte's 10th homer of his MLB career and four innings of shutout ball from Brady Basso lead the Athletics to a 2-0 win over the Blue Jays

murakami.title: Esmerlyn Valdez's home run fuels Pirates' 4-2 win
murakami.blurb: Esmerlyn Valdez lifts a solo home run to lead the Pirates to a 4-2 win over the White Sox

matsui.title: Jackson Merrill homers twice in Padres' 9-2 win
matsui.blurb: Jackson Merrill crushes two home runs in a four-hit game to lead the Padres to a 9-2 win over the Nationals
